lore: Greenkeeper Talwyn mows the links on the dunes above the harbour. She keeps the club rack, the wind sock and a slate of scorecards, chalks how the caddies would have played each hole beside yours, and knows the shortest way round every water hazard on the course.

lines.masterful: Not a stroke wasted. Even the gulls stopped to watch.
lines.steady: A caddie's round. My slate says there was a shorter way; go and read it.
lines.rough: Half the course is in the water and the rest is in the dunes. Even the lay-up caddie went round in fewer.
